llms.body:
# REVIEWS.io

> REVIEWS.io is an ecommerce-focused review collection and reputation management platform. It enables brands to collect verified Product and Company reviews, gather user-generated content (photos & videos), optimize conversion with on-site social proof, and improve paid search performance with Google Seller Ratings.

REVIEWS.io operates in the ecommerce review software category and integrates deeply with Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and custom ecommerce stacks via REST API.

REVIEWS.io also offers a loyalty and referrals platform called Influence.io, enabling brands to create loyalty programs, VIP tiers, referral campaigns, memberships, and rewards-based engagement programs.

---

## Features

- [Review Collection](https://www.reviews.io/front/review-collection): Automated email and SMS review invitations with customizable branding, segmentation, targeting controls, and AI-powered review management tools.

- [Product Reviews](https://www.reviews.io/front/productreviews): Verified product-level reviews with SEO-friendly structured data, rich snippets, and customizable display widgets.

- [Company Reviews](https://www.reviews.io/front/company-reviews): Brand-level review collection and response management tools.

- [Google Seller Ratings](https://www.reviews.io/front/google-seller-ratings): Enables seller rating stars to appear in Google Ads and Shopping results.

- [Reputation Management](https://www.reviews.io/front/reputation-management): Tools for managing reputation across multiple review platforms to maintain strong, consistent ratings and online trust.

- [Flow Review Collection](https://www.reviews.io/front/flow-review-collection): Multi-step review invitation workflows allowing segmentation by purchase behavior, geography, or custom attributes.

- [UGC (Photos & Videos)](https://www.reviews.io/front/ugc): Collection and display of user-generated visual content, including review photos and videos.

- [Social Proof](https://www.reviews.io/front/social-proof): Social proof visuals based on collected reviews and UGC, designed to increase trust and engagement on ecommerce storefronts.

- [Review Nuggets](https://www.reviews.io/front/review-nuggets): Highlighted review excerpts placed near key conversion areas.

- [Attributes](https://www.reviews.io/front/attributes): Structured review data such as quality, fit, delivery performance, and other custom metrics.

- [AI Review Assistant](https://www.reviews.io/front/ai-review-assistant): AI-assisted tools for review analysis, response suggestions, and insight generation.

- [Surveys](https://www.reviews.io/front/surveys): Pre- and post-purchase surveys, including Net Promoter Score (NPS) and structured customer feedback reporting.

---

## Ecommerce Integrations

- [Integration Library](https://www.reviews.io/front/integration-library): Integrations with Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Dotdigital, Attentive, and other ecommerce and marketing tools.

- [Boost Integration](https://www.reviews.io/front/boost-integration): Deep integration with the Boost AI Search & Discovery app that enhances product discovery and merchandising through review data.

- [Developer API](https://developer.reviews.io/): REST API for custom integrations and automation workflows.

---

## Compare Alternatives

REVIEWS.io provides dedicated comparison pages analyzing differences in ecommerce focus, review and UGC functionality, pricing models, integration architecture, customization flexibility, data ownership policies, and migration support across review platforms.

- [Trustpilot Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/trustpilot-alternative)
- [Yotpo Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/yotpo-alternative)
- [Okendo Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/okendo-alternative)
- [Stamped.io Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/stamped-io-alternative)
- [Trusted Shops Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/trustedshops-alternative)
- [Bazaarvoice Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/bazaarvoice-alternative)
- [Judge.me Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/judge-me-alternative)
- [Loox Alternative](https://www.reviews.io/front/loox-alternative)

---

## Switching to REVIEWS.io

- [Switch Provider](https://www.reviews.io/front/switch-provider): Migration support from other review platforms to REVIEWS.io, including onboarding assistance and review data transfer guidance.

---

## Case Studies

- [Customer Success Stories](https://www.reviews.io/front/customer-success-stories): Case studies demonstrating revenue impact, review growth, and measurable conversion improvements.

---

## Pricing & Getting Started

- [Pricing Plans](https://www.reviews.io/front/pricingplans): Tiered pricing for ecommerce brands ranging from early-stage businesses to enterprise organizations.

- [Book a Demo](https://www.reviews.io/lets-chat): Schedule a product walkthrough and implementation discussion.

---

## Resources

- [Blog](https://blog.reviews.io/)
- [Product Updates](https://updates.reviews.io/)
- [Help Center](https://support.reviews.io/en/)

---

## Legal & Policies

- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.reviews.io/legal/termsconditions)
- [User Privacy Policy](https://www.reviews.io/legal/user-privacy-policy)
- [Business User Privacy Policy](https://www.reviews.io/legal/business-user-privacy-policy)

Frequently asked questions

Find answers to frequently asked questions about REVIEWS.io to help you better understand our features, services, and how we can support your needs.
What is REVIEWS.io?

REVIEWS.io is an ecommerce review platform that helps online brands collect, manage and display verified customer reviews, UGC and survey feedback. You can collect company reviews (about your business) and product reviews (about what you sell), then show them on your site, in emails and in ads to build trust and drive more sales.

How much does REVIEWS.io cost, and is there a free trial?

REVIEWS.io offers a 14-day free trial and flexible plans based on the number of review invitations you send each month. Billing is month to month, with 20% off annual billing, and no annual contract is required. Each store domain needs its own subscription, and you can move between plans as you grow.

Can I use REVIEWS.io alongside Trustpilot, or switch from it?

Yes. Many brands use both. You can send some review requests to platforms like Trustpilot and Google while collecting the rest on REVIEWS.io, so you keep your existing presence while building reviews you own. If you are switching, product reviews can be imported. Company reviews left on Trustpilot cannot be moved without customer permission, because Trustpilot holds the publishing rights. REVIEWS.io plans are month to month, and you own your reviews and can export them.

Do I own my reviews, and can I take them with me?

Yes. You own your reviews and UGC. You can export your data and take it with you if you ever leave.

When should I send review invitations, and should I send a reminder?

Send the invitation once your customer has had time to use the product, and follow up once. As a guide, send 3 to 5 days after the order for fast-use products such as consumables, 7 to 14 days for standard physical goods, and 14 to 21 days for high-consideration items such as furniture or appliances. REVIEWS.io defaults to 7 days. A single reminder sent 5 to 7 days after the first invitation consistently improves collection rates without feeling intrusive. Focus your invitations on customers who have actually purchased, so every review is verified.

What is a good review collection rate?

A good review collection rate is typically above 5%, meaning more than 5 in every 100 invitations turn into a review. Most REVIEWS.io customers who send invitations regularly see between 3% and 6%. Your rate will depend on when you send, whether you send a reminder and who you invite, so timing and follow-up are the quickest ways to improve it.

Can I ask past customers for reviews?

Yes. Review Booster lets you upload a list of past orders, with customer name, email address and order ID (plus product SKU for product reviews), and REVIEWS.io automatically sends review requests for them. Multiple products in one order are combined into a single email, and each customer receives only one company review invitation every three months, so past customers are not over-asked. Review Booster is available on Start-Up plans and above.
